text:
ITEM 1 | Large irregular piece of cooked light-pink meat with pale golden-brown crusty coating and craggy surface, moist and glossy in places, roughly 12 cm by 8 cm, about 3 cm thick, sitting at the left-center of the plate, partially covered by wilted green leaves | 260
ITEM 2 | Several chunks of yellow-gold roasted vegetable with browned edges and slightly caramelized surfaces, firm and cut into irregular wedges about 3 to 4 cm long, clustered below the meat on the left side of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Small dark brown-charred piece of roasted vegetable skin or peel, curled and crisp, about 3 cm across, lying at the lower edge of the yellow chunks | 12
ITEM 4 | Mixed raw leafy greens including curly dark green kale-like leaves and flatter spinach-like leaves, some with light dressing sheen, loosely piled on the right side of the plate, covering roughly a quarter of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Scattered small red pepper pieces, diced bright red, about 0.5 to 1 cm, mixed among the greens on the right | 8
ITEM 6 | Scattered small toasted nut or seed pieces, pale tan and irregular, about 0.3 to 0.5 cm, sprinkled over the greens and meat | 5
